name: upgrades
description: Dependency upgrades, with the npm-latest tool published on its own: a plugin that requires an item rather than copy it.

skills.name: upgrade
skills.description: How to upgrade a dependency. Use it whenever you upgrade or update a package.
skills.content:
# Upgrading a dependency

1. Look the package up with the npm-latest tool: its latest version and its license.
2. Install that exact version, pinned in package.json.
3. Run the tests, or the project, and say what changed.
